seoTitle: Cutshort Jobs Scraper - Salary, Skills, Experience
seoDescription: Search every Cutshort job in India by title, skill, city and years of experience. Get pay in lakhs, skills, funding stage and links, newest first.
defaultRunOptions$comment: Default 512 MB, measured on Apify on 2026-11-08 (build 1.0.2, engine v0.5.2): the example input (python developer, 100 jobs) took 43.5 s at 512 MB (0.0060 CU, $0.00189 at FREE prices), 34.7 s at 1 GB (0.0096 CU, $0.00260) and 18.8 s at 2 GB (0.0105 CU, $0.00277). 512 MB is the cheapest, and a run that reads many job pages is paced by Cutshort (about 7 pages a second at any memory: 5,000 pages in 712 s), so it costs in proportion to the memory; the start event charges once up to 1 GB, so 512 MB and 1 GB pay the same start. Peak memory of every measured run: 82 to 127 MB. timeoutSecs 3600: the most a run reads when a number of jobs is asked for is 5,000 job pages, about 12 minutes; every match of a broad search can take longer (every one of Cutshort's 44,962 jobs: about 100 to 110 minutes).

pricing.$comment: Priced from measured Apify runs (BRIEF-3.md section 3, owner, 2026-11-08: cost plus a 100-150% markup by tier, m = (0.8 x P - C) / C, FREE 150%, BRONZE 140%, SILVER 125%, GOLD 110%, PLATINUM and DIAMOND 100%, each price rounded up to 2 significant figures, none under $0.00001). Cost fit at 512 MB on cjWDGlvJ8yHuRbZXn, dm6j2TeQLNVwCLSx3, kUg4OdB52dNpHgksV, rDe9JHbniaK29a4lE, h6tzyNwwGFhIOWtrZ (https://docs.apify.com/platform/actors/publishing/monetize/pricing-and-costs.md unit prices; PLATINUM and DIAMOND at GOLD's): $0.0006863 a run + $0.000008574 a job + $0 more with details, at FREE. Ladder (price, markup): job FREE $0.000027 (152%), BRONZE $0.000026 (143%), SILVER $0.000021 (128%), GOLD $0.000017 (114%), PLATINUM $0.000016 (101%), DIAMOND $0.000016 (101%); job-details FREE $0.000027 (152%), BRONZE $0.000026 (143%), SILVER $0.000021 (128%), GOLD $0.000017 (114%), PLATINUM $0.000016 (101%), DIAMOND $0.000016 (101%). Run start $0.053 flat per GB: $0.0022 would cover the fixed cost of a run ($0.00069 at FREE prices, 512 MB) at 150%; raised so every measured run type keeps 100% or more on every tier. The binding one reads the most one run reads, 5,000 job pages (remote React jobs, run zqy8EIvhBiA6CMDez, $0.0211 at FREE), checked as if it had saved no job: 101% on FREE and BRONZE; with its 74 rows 109%. The fresher search (1,050 pages, 100 rows) sits at 858% or more. Apify's free first 5 s with the event on is not counted. House rule for comparison (SEO.md 16, 5-15% under getascraper/cutshort-scraper, read 2026-11-08): job $0.00111, job-details $0.00113 on FREE and BRONZE, 10% less on SILVER, 20% less on GOLD and up.

job.eventDescription: One saved job row: title, company, locations, remote or office, job type, pay as shown and as numbers, experience, skills, funding stage, company type and size, posting dates, job link. Also one checked job link that is closed or not found.

job-details.eventDescription: One saved job row with full details on: everything in a Job row plus the description as text and HTML, and the city and country of the first place.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged by Apify when a run starts: once up to 1 GB of memory and once more for each extra GB, so $0.053 at the default 512 MB. It pays for the job pages a run reads, which a narrow search reads many of for few jobs.
